notes.title: New Game COMING SOON! Add it to your wishlist now!
notes.content:
Locked in Temptation, a new choice-driven adult Visual Novel from Loys, is inching closer to launch – and we need your help to bring it to Steam!


What’s at stake? A world of drama, intrigue, and fiery romance where decisions you make unravels secrets, forges bonds, and determines your fate. What starts as a simple job to pay rent spirals into a thrilling journey of betrayal, transformation, and connections with unforgettable women. Will you uncover the truth… or lose yourself in the chaos?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44679957/00fe08341bbe8a1f4004025b8083c1d7b1b4fe61.png

Why Wishlist Locked in Temptation?


  1,000+ Stunning Renders – Dive into a visually gripping world.
  Animations – Passionate moments that bring relationships to life.
 A Mystery That Demands Answers – Unravel hidden agendas and lies.
 Shape Your Story – Every choice alters relationships and endings.
  2–4 Hours of Replayable Drama – Explore new paths, girls, and outcomes with every playthrough.
 Scene Gallery – Relive your favorite moments anytime.


Steam’s visibility rules are tough – we need YOUR wishlists to ensure Locked in Temptation gets the spotlight it deserves. This takes 10 seconds, costs nothing, and helps us deliver more content for you.

notes.title: My Pleasure - Season 3: Release Date!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Just dropping in to share some news – "My Pleasure - Season 3" is all set for release on March 29th. Alongside the main game, we're also rolling out an Advanced Walkthrough, Wallpapers, and the Soundtrack. It's quite the package, and we're pretty excited to get it into your hands.

What to Look Forward To:
This season is packed with about 10-15 hours of gameplay, which is pretty solid. You've got a bunch of different paths to explore, and it’s designed for multiple playthroughs. So, there's a lot to uncover based on the choices you make.

Here's the Scoop on the New Stuff:


 We’ve included over 5,000 images. Yeah, we’ve been busy.
 Added more than 500 animations to make things feel more alive.
 There are 37 new Steam Achievements for the achievement hunters out there.
 Expect a decent chunk of gameplay time, somewhere between 10 and 15 hours.
 The game features a mix of scenes with various characters – should keep things interesting.
 We've also put in a Holiday Special Event.
 Plus, there are plenty of Extra Scenes and reasons to go through the game a few times.



If this sounds like something you’d enjoy, consider adding it to your wishlist. That way, you won't miss out on the release!

Tasty Pics Studio.
